meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出两个 MCP 工具,用来调用 Atomic Chat 桌面应用在本机提供的模型:先列出当前可用的模型,再把提示发给指定模型并拿回回答。
howto.when: 当 Atomic Chat 桌面应用已安装、其本地 API 服务在 1337 端口运行,且需要让容器代理调用本地模型时触发。

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里现在可用的模型
用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains two MCP tools to call models served locally by the Atomic Chat desktop app: list the currently available models, then send a prompt to a chosen model and return its reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the Atomic Chat desktop app is installed with its local API server running on port 1337 and the container agent needs to call a local model.

say_en.text: List the models currently available in atomic chat
say_en.note: Calls atomic_chat_list_models and returns model IDs

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models first, then generates a reply

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: what is 1+1
say_en.note: Generates with the model ID you pick
